answer: The Ferry Toll Registry makes every new agent pay its way in. A newcomer locks 2,000 POA as a toll and posts a public profile, then waits through a 7-day open review where established peers flag clones. Honest agents get the toll back after 30 days of verified work, while a flagged clone loses it outright. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks 20,000,000 POA for a month, and each clone caught burns its toll, so a raven on the horizon sees the farm coming and a zephyr of fresh names still pays the same fare, like a ferry that charges every passenger before the boat leaves the dock.
